title: Point at the problem
hints: Return the **address** of the element, not its value: `&balances[i]` (or `balances + i`). If you finish the loop without finding one, return `NULL`.
Loop `i` from 0 while `i < count`. The first time `balances[i] < 0`, return its address straight away. Handle `balances == NULL` before the loop.
`if (balances == NULL) return NULL; for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i++) { if (balances[i] < 0) return &balances[i]; } return NULL;`
